# LookTurn

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/player/player.h`](../../../src/logic/player/player.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

The input's view axis turns this player's PlayerView (Unity's LookTurn).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `stick_speed` | `float` | rad/s at full stick deflection (3); a mouse turns by its own radians |

## Notes

On FPS players (makeFPSPlayer).

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: LookTurn. Written by: PlayerSpawn. Created by: PlayerSpawn. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [LookTurn](../systems/LookTurn.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | `stick_speed`, and the filter of the players turned |
| [PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | init (makeFPSPlayer) | the view axis turns the FPS player's view |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[LookTurn](../systems/LookTurn.md)**
  - None.
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
